content: Agyʋ́másʋ́ Ɔkɩ́pʋ Ansɩtɩ́npʋ Ɔkʋ
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩwɩ onyapʋ́ ɔkʋ létsiá, ɔbʋ agyʋ́másʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ. Ahá bowi tsá mʋ wie amʋsʋ bɛɛ ɔdɛ mʋ gyí.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔlɛtɩ oyin ámʋ, fɩ́tɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ntɔ asʋ́n ndenu tsú fʋ́ ɩwɩ alɩ? Bobu akúnta ha mɩ, tsúfɛ́ fʋmɛ́ɛtrá kɩ mɩ́ agyʋ́másʋ́.’
Agyʋ́másʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ amʋ lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɩwɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Nkálɩ nɔ́bwɛ? Mɩ́ wíe ɔbá begya mɩ. Mma ɔwʋnlɩ́n ánɩ́ nɛ́natɩ́ dɔ ha ahá. Ɩbʋ mɩ pɛ́lɩ ánɩ́ nɛ́natɩ́ kʋ́lɩ́ atɔ́ ɛ́.
Ɩbʋ alɛ́! Nyin tɔ́á nɔ́bwɛ, mɛ́nɩ nɩ́ osí mɩ́ á, nénya ahá ánɩ́ bɔ́hɔ mɩ wá amʋ́ wóyítɔ́.’
“Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛtɩ ahá ánɩ́ bʋdɛ mʋ wie ɩkɔ kʋlɛkʋlɛ. Ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ ogyankpapʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ɩkɔ afɩnɩ fʋ́dɛ mɩ́ wíe?’
Ɩkɔ ɔkɩtápʋ́ amʋ lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Nfɔ agbɔngbɔ́ lafa-anyɔ (200).’ Agyʋ́másʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ amʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Tsan fʋ́ adánsɩɛ ɔwʋlʋ́ ámʋtɔ, afʋwanlɩn lafakʋlɛ (100).’

Ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ ɔkʋ ɛ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ɩkɔ afɩnɩ fʋ́dɛ?’ Ɩkɔ ɔkɩtápʋ́ amʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Bodobodo nfúó akɛntɛ ɔpɩ́m-ɔkʋlɛ (1,000).’ Agyʋ́másʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ amʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Tsan fʋ́ adánsɩɛ ɔwʋlʋ́ ámʋtɔ afʋwanlɩn lafakwe (800).’

“Osikani ámʋ lɛ́kanfʋ́ agyʋ́másʋ́ ɔkɩ́pʋ anfɩ́ ɔma ɔnɔkwalɩ ánfɩ ánɩ́ alatálɩ́ tɩn ansɩ́ alɩ.” Yesu lɔ́mɔ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ndɛmba-abí ánɩ́ bʋbuo ɔyɩ́tɔ́ atɔ́ ansɩtɩ́ɩn ánɩ́ bɔpʋ bʋtsie amʋ́ abatɔ ɩdʋn amʋ́á bʋyin Bulu klɛ́.
“Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, mlɩpʋ ɔyɩ́tɔ́ atɔ́ bwɛ apíó, mɛ́nɩ nɩ́ ɩtá á, Bulu ɔbɔ́hɔ mlɩ wá mʋ wóyíá ɩbʋ ɩnʋ brɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́.

Ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔlɛtalɩ́ kɩ́tá atɔ́ túkúrííbi, olegyi ɔnɔkwalɩ mʋ́sʋ́ á, mʋ kɛ́n obégyi ɔnɔkwalɩ atɔ́ kpɔnkpɔntɩ ɛ́sʋ́ nɩ. Támɛ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔmɔwa ɔnɔkwalɩ atɔ́ túkúrííbisʋ ɔmɔ́ɔwa ɔnɔkwalɩ atɔ́ kpɔnkpɔntɩsʋ.
Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ mlɩmá ɔnɔkwalɩ ɔyɩ́tɔ́ atɔ́sʋ́ a, ma mɛɛ ɔbɔ́hɔ mlɩsʋ gyi, pʋ́ ɔsʋ́sʋ́ atɔ́ onutó wá mlɩ ɩbɩtɔ?
Ntɛ́ɛ nɩ́ fʋma ɔnɔkwalɩ ɔkʋ klɛ́sʋ á, ma mɛɛ ɔbɔ́pʋ fʋ́ klɛ́ há fʋ́?
“Osúmpʋ́ ɔkʋkʋ mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ súm awie anyɔ. Ɔbɔ́dwɛ ɔkʋlɛ, lú ɔkʋlɛ. Ntɛ́ɛ obóbu ɔkʋlɛ, omóobu ɔkʋlɛ. Fʋmɛ́ɛtalɩ́ súm Bulu, súm Kɔ́ba.”
Yesu Asʋn Blɩ́hɛ́ Kʋ
Farisifɔ bʋtɔdwɛ́ kɔ́ba. Mʋ́ sʋ brɛ́á bonu Yesu asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ anfɩ á, bɔbwɛ mʋ ahinlá.
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩtɛlɛ́ ɩwɩ súná ánɩ́ aha yilé mlɩgyí ahá ansɩ́tɔ́, támɛ Bulu mʋ́ yin mlɩ klʋntɔ. Tsúfɛ́ tɔ́á nyankpʋsa tɛkɩá ɩbʋ labi igyi Bulu akisítɔ.

“Mose Mbla ámʋ pʋ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ lɔyɔ agyʋ́má alɩɩ bɔfʋn Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane brɛ́sʋ́. Tsú mʋsʋ bʋdɛ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ ɩwɩ asʋn wankláán ɔkan da, ahá ɛ́ bʋdɛprɩ́ɩ wie mʋ́tɔ́.
Ɔsʋ́ mʋ́a asɩ bɛ́talɩ́ mɔ́ ɔnɔ́, támɛ itoduáhɛ́ ntɛ́ɛ asʋ́nbi ɩkʋlɛ kʋ́ráá móowu Mose Mbla ámʋtɔ.
“Oyin okíná mʋ ka láyétsiá ɔtsɩ bámbá á, alatɔ́ mbʋa. Oyingyíoyin ánɩ́ otsía ɔtsɩ ánfɩ mʋ kulu lakíná mʋ ɛ́ latɔ́ mbʋa.”
Ɩwɩ Onyapʋ́ Ɔkʋ Mʋa Lasaro
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩwɩ onyapʋ́ ɔkʋ létsiá. Atati wʋlɩhɛ ɔtɛdɩ́dá, otegyi nkpa wankláán ekekegyíɛkɛ.
Atɔ́ ɔkʋ́lɩ́pʋ́ ɔkʋá mʋ ɩwɩ letsitsíí nlɔ ɛ́ létsiá. Bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Lasaro. Betsiá pʋ́ ohiáni ánfɩ yɛ́yaɩ́ ɩwɩ onyapʋ́ ámʋ ɔkpa ɔnɔ́.
Ɔkɩá obénya atogyihɛ mpupubiá ɩbɛ́kpakpáa bun oyin ámʋ ɔpʋ́nʋ́asɩ gyi. Akɩ́aɩ létsiá beyintá mʋ nlɔ ámʋ kʋ́ráátɔ́.
“Brɛ́á ohiáni ánfɩ lówu á, Bulu-abɔpʋ botsu mʋ ya, oleyétsiá anɩ náin Abraham wá ɔsʋ́sʋ́. Ɩwɩ onyapʋ́ ánfɩ ɛ́ lóbowu, bopulá mʋ.
Ɔlɔyɔ ɔbʋ ɩsʋbɩtɩ́ ogyá ánɩ́ ɩtamaduntɔ, ɔdɛ ɩwɩɔsɩn wúun. Olotsu ansɩ́ fʋ́á, olowun ánɩ́ Lasaro tsie Abraham wá tsútsúútsú.
Ɩnʋ ɔlɔkplʋ́n ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Anɩ sɩ́ Abraham-ée! Wun mɩ nwɛ, afʋha Lasaro ɔyɔpʋ mʋ osrebi da ntsutso pʋbɛda mɩ́ ɔdandʋsʋ, ilwii kpalobí. Ndɛ ɩwɩɔsɩn wúun ogyá ánfɩtɔ dʋbɩ!’
“Támɛ Abraham lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Obí, kaɩn, fʋ́ nkpatsiátɔ́ a, fegyi ɔdwɛ, Lasaro ɛ́ letsiá ɔsɩntɔ. Séi á, ɔbʋ ɔdwɛtɔ, fʋ́ ɛ́ fʋ́bʋ ɔsɩntɔ.
Ɔma a, ɩlán kpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ kʋ da anɩa fʋnyɔ nsɩnɛ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔhaa mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ fá tsú nfɩ ba fʋ́ wá ɩnʋ, ɔhaa ɛ́ mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ fá tsú ɩnʋ ba anɩ wá nfɩ.’
Oyin ámʋ lɛ́bláa Abraham ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mʋ́mʋ́ nobwíí ɩpa, anɩ sɩ́ Abraham, wa Lasaro sɩsɩ mɩ́ sɩ́ wóyítɔ́.
Mbʋ apio yinhɛ́ abanú akʋ ɩnʋ, ɔyɛda amʋ́ ɔlá, mɛ́nɩ bowú á, bʋmɛ́ɛba bowun ɩwɩɔsɩn ánfɩ odu.’
“Abraham lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Mose mʋa Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ nwʋlʋ́ bʋ amʋ́ wá, ɩdɛ amʋ́ ɔlá da. Bʋnúu mʋ́, abʋgyi mʋ́sʋ́.’
Oyin ámʋ lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Anɩ sɩ́ Abraham, asʋ́n ámʋ nu kɛkɛ mɛ́ɛha amʋ́ abʋdamli klʋntɔ. Mboún nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɔkʋ́sʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ yɔ́ amʋ́ wá á, bɛ́damlí klʋntɔ.’
Támɛ Abraham lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Nɩ́ bʋmegyi Mose mʋa Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ nwʋlʋ́tɔ́ asʋ́n ámʋsʋ á, ɔkʋ ɔkʋ́sʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ yɔ́ ɩnʋ kʋ́ráá á, bʋmóonu ɔhá ámʋ asʋ́n.’ ”
